name: tracker-readonly-db
goal: A native Tracker node refuses to start on a database file its owner cannot write, instead of starting and answering every write with HTTP 500 and no log (found in the ente8j cutover rehearsal)

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Failing: a native Tracker node started on an initialized journal whose file mode lacks owner write (0400) starts, opens SQLite read-only, and answers every write (CLI add, hub /sync/push) with HTTP 500, logging nothing. Expected: startup refuses with exit 1 and a clear reason, leaving the journal untouched. Reproduction: ente8j rehearsal run-185/sbs/attempt1 (cp kept 0400 from candidate.sqlite; lsof showed fd 10r; legacy spokes logged 'hub HTTP 500'); e2e test 'startup refuses a journal its owner cannot write instead of serving failed writes'.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: test/tracker-node.e2e.test.ts covered unfenced role, competing API/sync/journal owners and lease release, but only with writable fresh fixtures; a fresh 0400 journal already fails at schema init with a generic message, so the gap was an INITIALIZED journal that later loses write permission (restore/copy from a 0400 backup). Reusable change: the startup-refusal test now initializes the journal through a normal start/stop before chmod 0400, asserts exit 1, the printed reason, and byte-identical journal.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase red at 6bfa33aa6b: 'bunx vitest run test/tracker-node.e2e.test.ts -t journal its owner cannot write' failed with 'expected null to be 1' (node kept serving the read-only journal until the 8s kill).

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: b4539f2077: verifyTrackerJournalWritable (trackerNodeConfig.ts) checks R/W on the journal and W/X on its directory before the lease is taken and throws TrackerNodeStartupError; TrackerServeCommand prints the message of TrackerNodeStartupError (fixed operator strings, no paths or secrets) before the generic line. Test unchanged from red commit 6bfa33aa6b.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase green passed at b4539f2077 with the unchanged red command; full test/tracker-node.e2e.test.ts 4/4 pass locally.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
